expert_panel.finding: coarse views are useful navigation representations only if relational and negative evidence can still be recovered at finer resolution
derived views require typed direct-source identity, transitive canonical roots, erasure metadata and authority non-escalation
summary-first retrieval should terminate in inspectable source evidence when exact authority or detail is required
the memory-view relation must be an acyclic hash-pinned DAG; lossy mappings are not assumed invertible and transform labels are not reconstruction proofs
multiple resolution views should coexist as alternate search coordinates rather than one destructive global summary
hostile cases must include dangling lineage, stale hashes, cycles, dropped contradiction sides, false exact-reconstruction claims and authority escalation

review_independence_note: All six role passes shared one orchestration context and are not claimed as independent review.

next_ai.positive: After exact-head promotion, freeze META_N077 normal-LLM reference profiles and META_N078 clean-install E2E workflows before integrating memory/context support into default execution.
next_ai.null: If flat or ordinary hierarchical memory matches source recall, negative-history integrity and downstream decisions at equal or lower cost, preserve the null and keep reconstructable views optional.
next_ai.refuted: If a hostile or real task shows a valid view can lose a required canonical root or overstate reconstruction/authority, preserve the counterexample and revise only under a new frozen benchmark.
next_ai.partial_id: Keep metadata-lineage closure separate from payload-storage, retrieval and real-agent utility claims.
next_ai.blocked: If canonical source identity or pinned hashes cannot be resolved, return INVALID rather than treating the compact view as evidence.
next_ai.transport: If main moves before promotion, rebuild/revalidate on current main while retaining the frozen benchmark and all negative history.
